##### Adolfo Eslava Gómez

**Director of EAFIT Social and head of the Master's program in Social Enterprise Management for Social Innovation and Local Development**

He assumed office on March 1, 2024

He holds a doctorate in Political Studies from the Externado University of Colombia, a master's degree in Economic Sciences from the National University of Colombia, a specialist degree in Social Evaluation of Projects from the University of Los Andes, and a degree in Economics from the University of Antioquia.

At EAFIT, Adolfo has been dean of the School of Arts and Humanities; director of the Humanist Center of this same school; tenured professor of Government and Political Science; coordinator of the master's program in Government and Public Policy; director of the research group Society, Politics and Connected Histories; and senior researcher in the Colciencias classification.

He is the author of the books \*Experimenting to Decide\* (EAFIT, 2019), \*Politicians, Technicians, and Communities\* (EAFIT, 2017), and \*The Game of Public Policy\* (EAFIT, 2011); co-author of \*Values, Representations, and Social Capital in Antioquia\* (EAFIT-SURA-Government of Antioquia, 2013); academic editor of \*The Best of People\* (EAFIT-Mayor's Office of Medellín, 2019) and \*Gold as Fortune\* (EAFIT-Colciencias, 2014); and co-editor of \*Territory, Crime, Community\* (EAFIT-Open Society, 2015). He has also published several articles and book chapters on topics related to institutional analysis, experimental economics, and public policy.

[![Image by Jesus Alonso Botero](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/ed86a390-43ca-402e-9ac4-c3f9d074be96/web/jesus-alonso-botero.jpg)](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/comunicados-institucionales/comunicados-2024/nuevos-nombramientos-en-la-escuela-de-finanzas-economia-y-gobierno)

![](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/comunicados-institucionales/comunicados-2024/nuevos-nombramientos-en-la-escuela-de-finanzas-economia-y-gobierno)

##### Jesús Alonso Botero García

**Director of the Markets and Financial Strategy area**

He assumed office on February 19, 2024

Jesús Alonso Botero, recognized as Professor Emeritus of EAFIT in 2019, is a specialist in Economic Policy and an economist from the University of Antioquia. His teaching career at EAFIT began in 2001 as an adjunct professor in the subject of Game Theory, and later he went on to lead the Economic Outlook course, which he continues to teach today.

Professor Jesús Botero is part of the Markets and Financial Strategies area and participates in research projects on economic trends, informal employment, social security, and productive transformation, as well as on general equilibrium models with energy transformation and technological progress in disruptive environments. His research interests focus on general economic equilibrium, environmental and social sustainability, and game theory.

Throughout his career, he has been recognized for his work in research and public policy. These distinctions include the ANIF Research and Public Policy Award in 2021 and the Nicanor Restrepo Santamaría Award for Social Research in 2022 for his work on the Bien+ research project.

In addition to his academic and research work, he has held leadership roles, including serving on the boards of directors of XM and New Stetic; holding the positions of Vice-Rector of Extension and Vice-Rector in charge of Science and Technology at the University of Medellín; and serving as General Manager of the Center for Non-Invasive Treatments SAS.

Sincerely,

**César Tamayo Tobón,**

**Dean of the School of Finance, Economics and Government**

**Press Release No. 8**

**Medellín, March 5, 2024**
